ground_truth.unit: standard deviations of the perception index
ground_truth.location: Table 3, Panel A, Democrat, column (4) Perception Index
ground_truth.context: Table 3 ("Correlates of perceptions"), Panel A, column (4).  OLS of the perception summary index on a Democrat indicator (Democrats include Independents leaning Democrat), a Female indicator, indicators for Independent and "other" political orientation (Republicans, incl. Independents leaning Republican, are the reference) and a dummy for survey wave B.  The index combines the three perception items of columns (1)-(3) (gender differences in wages are large, are a problem, government should mitigate the gap), each z-scored on the pure control group, following Anderson (2008). Sample: the pure control group of the main survey (no information), both waves, restricted to respondents whose prior belief about females' relative wages lies strictly between the 5th and 95th percentiles.  Probability weights; robust standard errors.  The entry is the Democrat coefficient.

ground_truth.unit: dollars per $100 earned by a man (posterior belief, 0-200 scale)
ground_truth.location: Table 5, Panel A: First Stage, T74, column (1)
ground_truth.context: Table 5 ("Treatment effect on perceptions and demand for specific policies"), Panel A, column (1).  OLS of the respondent's posterior belief about females' relative wages (dollars per $100 a man earns, pooled across the five randomized versions of the posterior wage statistic) on T74, a dummy for the high-wage-gap information arm (told the ACS-based statistic) versus the low-wage-gap arm (told the CPS-based statistic).  Sample: the two treatment arms of the main survey, both waves (pure control group excluded).  Controls: survey wave, gender, prior belief, census region, age categories, having a child, log household income, at least a 2-year college degree, full-time, part-time, self-employed, unemployed, student, Democrat, Independent and "other" political orientation.  Probability weights; robust standard errors.
